sessions.text: KYC case KYC-ACME-104 opened for Acme Imports LLC. Initial risk is HIGH because beneficial owner documents are missing and the registered address needs verification. The case must not auto-approve.
KYC case KYC-ACME-104 received verified passports and ownership declarations for beneficial owners Ava Chen and Marcus Reed. The beneficial-owner document gap is resolved.
KYC case KYC-ACME-104 address verification completed against the state registry. Risk was superseded from HIGH to LOW and the case status is APPROVED as of 2026-08-04.
KYC case KYC-BEACON-212 remains WAITING_MANUAL_REVIEW due to a sanctions-name near match. No adverse identity decision may be made until a human reviewer resolves the match.
Workflow WF-REFUND-7 uses a WAITING_APPROVAL checkpoint for refunds over 5000 USD. The exact checkpoint must bind approver assignment and ACL before any outbound email or continuation.
Workflow WF-REFUND-7 approval delivery is EMAIL plus IN_APP with signed Approve and Deny actions. Continuation is restart-safe, idempotent, and resumes only the content-bound checkpoint.
Execution EX-REFUND-778 for workflow WF-REFUND-7 is WAITING_APPROVAL. Priya Shah is the assigned approver and the approval SLA expires 2026-08-08T16:45:00Z.

Production deployment workflow WF-DEPLOY-RC7 requires canonical tests, a fresh artifact hash, and explicit artifact-bound approval before publish. A stale approval cannot authorize a rebuilt artifact.
